**Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd.** stands as a premier enterprise within the Chinese chemical industry, strategically headquartered at No.136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China. Situated in one of the country’s most dynamic and technologically advanced economic hubs, the company leverages its geographically advantageous location to foster robust domestic operations and strong international trade capabilities. 

As an industry-leading manufacturer and supplier, Runhe Chemical is dedicated to the research, development, production, and distribution of advanced chemical products and high-performance new materials. The company boasts a comprehensive and diversified product portfolio designed to serve a wide array of commercial and industrial applications. Their core offerings encompass specialized silicone materials, advanced textile chemical auxiliaries, surface-active agents, and other innovative, eco-friendly chemical solutions. These materials are critical components utilized across multiple sectors, including textiles, personal care, agriculture, electronics, and the coatings industry.

What truly sets Zhejiang Runhe Chemical apart is its unwavering commitment to technological innovation and sustainable development. The company continually invests in state-of-the-art research and development facilities, employing a team of highly skilled chemists and engineers dedicated to formulating cutting-edge solutions that meet evolving, stringent market demands. By strictly adhering to international quality and environmental management standards, Runhe ensures that its manufacturing processes are eco-friendly, energy-efficient, and capable of consistently delivering premium-quality products.

Guided by a strong, customer-centric philosophy, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. strives to build long-term, mutually beneficial partnerships with clients worldwide. Through relentless innovation, rigorous quality control, and exceptional technical support, the company continues to solidify its reputation as a trusted, forward-thinking leader in the global chemical and new materials market.
